name: input_copyable
title: Input Copyable
description: A read-only field with a button that copies its value to the clipboard.

classes.name: input--copied
classes.description: Added by the script after a successful copy; it animates the button icon.

attributes.name: data-input-copyable-target="input"
attributes.description: The field whose value is copied.

actions.name: copy
actions.description: Writes the value to the clipboard and adds input--copied to the wrapper.

notes: The Clipboard API needs a secure context (https or localhost).
